summary: Follower Wave 3 (issue #174): wires up 28 previously-unwired Follower-type cards from the reference catalogue, found by re-auditing all 105 Followers Wave 2 left blocked against the primitives now available (aggregate/group Force effects -- Senior Infantry Legion, Ashigaru Elite, Utaku Elite Guard, all three wired to their real cards for the first time -- plus province adjacency). New small reusable additions: CardDefinition.AttachGrantsKeyword (an attachment granting its wielder a keyword, first published use of the pre-existing Attachment-duration GrantedKeyword lifecycle), a destruction-triggered Honor gain (DestroyedDuringBattleBonus, checked at both destruction paths), a keyword-based unit-scoped UnitFollowerBoost variant, a Melee-only Attack immunity, a Force-swap effect, two compound Target categories, and a shared BattlefieldParent helper (refactored out of ArmyBattleMaidenBoost, reused by the new same-name-in-army counting Effect). Moto Gunso composes two of this session's own primitives directly. Confirmed 'Political' card text is not a blocker -- it maps onto the already-existing Open/BattleOrOpen Timing values. Shared-file note: touches L5R.Core (rules engine primitives), its test suite, content/published/follower-wave-3.json plus its -sources.json, a new tools/content/package_follower_wave_3.py, and docs/ROADMAP.md/docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx -- a single rules-lane content wave; no UI/client files touched.
validation: New FollowerWave3Cards test (many focused sub-blocks, one or more per new mechanic and several of the simpler direct-reuse cards). Full suite: 103/103 core + 34/34 published + 8/8 deck format pass. bash tools/check.sh --skip-client passes (13/13 AI, 5/5 server integration, 4/4 client transport integration). docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx regenerated (167 wired, up from 139).
remaining: 77 Followers remain blocked on real gaps (new Reaction triggers, card creation, Dueling, Rings, Engage window, control-transfer, Transfer, deck search, Invest, a performer-keyed Attack-strength axis, and several one-off single-card gaps) -- full breakdown in issue #174; per-card blocker issues to follow individually as a separate pass.
